analysis_policy.question_intervals: Conditional 95% Wilson and paired-example percentile; IID/exchangeability may fail for same-source activities/contexts
analysis_policy.training_variability: Individual trained seeds and mean/sample SD ddof=1; questions/final/best are not training replicates

checkpoint_payload_verification: Stored SHA/model-state proof identity only; no analysis-stage checkpoint payload reads
first_read_rule: After exact true ROOT authority, full state/attestation closure, successful original check; exclusive per-manifest journal then unchanged original analyze
